links.statement: The prohibition against possessing wine, beer, or distilled spirits while on duty or operating a commercial motor vehicle does not apply to possession of wine, beer, or distilled spirits that are manifested and transported as part of a shipment.

The prohibition against possessing wine, beer, or distilled spirits while on duty or operating a commercial motor vehicle does not apply to possession of wine, beer, or distilled spirits that are possessed or used by bus passengers.

links.statement: A stop need not be made at a streetcar crossing, or railroad tracks used exclusively for industrial switching purposes, within a business district, as defined in 49 CFR 390.5.
A stop need not be made at a railroad grade crossing when a police officer or crossing flagman directs traffic to proceed.

A stop need not be made at a railroad grade crossing controlled by a functioning highway traffic signal transmitting a green indication which, under local law, permits the commercial motor vehicle to proceed across the railroad tracks without slowing or stopping.
A stop need not be made at an abandoned railroad grade crossing which is marked with a sign indicating that the rail line is abandoned.
A stop need not be made at an industrial or spur line railroad grade crossing marked with a sign reading “Exempt.”

De minimis releases associated with good faith attempts to recycle or recover refrigerants are not subject to the venting prohibition, where (except for exempt substitutes) refrigerant releases are de minimis only if they occur when: (i) the applicable practices in §§ 82.155 and 82.156 are observed, the applicable practices in § 82.157 are observed for appliances that contain any class I or class II refrigerant or blend containing a class I or class II refrigerant, recovery and/or recycling machines that meet the requirements in § 82.158 are used whenever refrigerant is removed from an appliance, the technician certification provisions in § 82.161 are observed, and the reclamation requirements in § 82.164 are observed; or (ii) the requirements in subpart B of this part are observed.
